verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway/AI Gateway provide the building blocks for scoped, least-privilege access — OAuth2/JWT/ACL auth plugins tied to Consumers (kong-gh-8), Dev Portal self-service credential management (kong-docs-21), Vaults for secret storage (kong-docs-20, kong-docs-47, kong-docs-48), and AI Gateway entitlements/metering per agent context (kong-docs-55) — which together let an operator issue and scope credentials per consumer/agent. There is no single documented feature explicitly framed as 'issue a scoped API key for an AI agent'; it must be composed from generic auth/ACL/consumer-group primitives. Missing for 10: an explicit, agent-specific credential-issuance workflow/doc, and independent/hands-on evidence that scoped agent credentials work as intended in practice.
